summary: Specifies how defect states are mapped between Ethernet attachment circuits and the Ethernet pseudowires linked to them, so an end-to-end emulated Ethernet service can report failures consistently. It standardizes how provider edge routers react to defects on either side.

eli5.summary: If a road is broken, signs must tell the next town. This says how network boxes pass the news of a broken link along.

questions: pe behavior on ethernet pw defects
